title: Bespoke Labs Raises $40M to Build Fake Companies for AI Agents
description:
Bespoke Labs raised $40M across a Series A led by Wing VC and a seed round backed by Jeff Dean.
The startup builds simulated workplaces, complete with code, email, and chat logs, so AI agents can practice long tasks.
Follow for daily AI news.
